lines.trans: Welcome back! Under our rules, please welcome the wild-card singer from first-place Team Xin Huimei — Bai Yang!
What's this — wasn't last week's duet lively enough? Let's hear what your mentor thinks first.
I refuse to share the stage with Bai Yang a second time.
Everyone out there is gossiping that Bai Yang's voice sounds just like someone else's, yet I don't see it that way at all.
I think Bai Yang's voice is remarkably distinctive.
Bai Yang, you don't need to imitate anyone — and you certainly don't need to imitate me.
This song Arbor brims with Eastern poetic charm; I believe it is a match made in heaven for you.

words.gram: Meaning: be full of, brim with.

lines.trans: So I refuse to steal any of your spotlight.
Every singer deserves a signature song of her very own, and I believe Arbor is yours!
Now we just need to ask the gentleman seated below the stage — Mr Chun Yuqiao.
